players.product: dedicated bare-metal AI infrastructure (GPU clusters) designed, deployed, owned and operated for enterprises; Axe Compute Build build-to-order program

quarterly_data.signal: Axe Compute 8-K (press release): a new five-year Build agreement with total committed contract value of over $1.5 billion to deploy a dedicated U.S. cluster of over 9,200 NVIDIA Blackwell B300 GPUs that Axe designs, deploys, owns and operates, including ancillary services for token production and dedicated networking for high-speed inference. It anticipated over $534 million of aggregate customer prepayments over the next 30 days across this and previously announced contracts, expected to cover a substantial portion of the associated GPU and infrastructure capex; the expected run rate of over $696 million is nearly double the $385 million run rate reported earlier in July.
quarterly_data.figure: over $1.5 billion five-year contract; over 9,200 NVIDIA B300 GPUs; over $534 million prepayments expected; $385 million prior run rate
